question: Should this repository accept Fuse.js 7.5.0’s corrected scoring and ranking behavior for existing knowledge-base searches?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and CI passes, but the upstream minor release explicitly changes search result scores and ordering, which is a product-visible compatibility choice rather than a branch repair.

options.title: Validate representative searches before merging
options.body: Check a small set of representative knowledge-base queries and merge if the corrected ranking remains acceptable.

options.title: Accept the upstream ranking correction
options.body: Merge based on the passing checks and treat changed result ordering as the intended upstream bug-fix behavior.

options.title: Hold at 7.4.2
options.body: Keep the current resolution if stable legacy ordering is more important than the upstream ranking fixes.

recommendation.title: Validate representative searches before merging
recommendation.body: Check a small set of representative knowledge-base queries and merge if the corrected ranking remains acceptable.
